description: A neonate of 10 days has a general anaesthetic with an arterial line running from its start to its end, whose arterial means fall below 40 at 09:10, 09:11, 09:17 and 09:18, with a cuff mean of 60 at 09:12 in the middle of that run. Under the present rule, which keeps every reading and lets each stand until the next for no longer than five minutes, the cuff mean interrupts the low run and the readings below 40 stand for 4 minutes. When the arterial line alone is used once it is running, the query sets the cuff mean aside, the arterial mean of 36 at 09:11 then stands until 09:17 but for no longer than five minutes, and the readings below 40 stand for 8 minutes.

expectations.says: The child is a neonate of 10 days at the start and has no recorded death.
expectations.query: SELECT a.age_days, COUNT(d.person_id) AS died_within_90_days FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id LEFT JOIN omop.death d ON d.person_id = a.person_id AND d.death_date >= CAST(a.start_datetime AS date) AND d.death_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, CAST(a.start_datetime AS date)) WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990004400' GROUP BY a.age_days

expectations.says: Under the present rule the query keeps all eight readings, the cuff mean of 60 stands from 09:12 until the arterial mean at 09:17, and the four arterial means below 40 stand for one minute each, so the readings below 40 stand for 4 minutes.
expectations.query: WITH reading AS (SELECT a.anaesthetic_id, a.end_datetime, m.measurement_datetime, m.value_as_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.anaesthetic_id, m.measurement_datetime ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 21490852 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.measurement_id) AS kept_at_time FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.measurement_event_id = a.anaesthetic_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (21492241, 21490852) AND m.measurement_datetime >= a.start_datetime AND (a.end_datetime IS NULL OR m.measurement_datetime <= a.end_datetime) WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990004400'), stood AS (SELECT value_as_number, measurement_datetime, COALESCE(LEAD(measurement_datetime) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_datetime), end_datetime) AS until_datetime FROM reading WHERE kept_at_time = 1) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN value_as_number < 40 AND until_datetime IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(second, measurement_datetime, until_datetime) > 300 THEN 300 ELSE DATEDIFF(second, measurement_datetime, until_datetime) END ELSE 0 END), 0) / 60.0 AS minutes_below_40, COUNT(*) AS kept_readings FROM stood

expectations.says: When the arterial line alone is used once it is running, the query sets aside the cuff mean, which falls between the line's first and last readings, and keeps seven readings; the arterial mean of 36 at 09:11 then stands until 09:17 but for no longer than five minutes, so the readings below 40 stand for 8 minutes.
expectations.query: WITH reading AS (SELECT a.anaesthetic_id, a.end_datetime, m.measurement_datetime, m.value_as_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.anaesthetic_id, m.measurement_datetime ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 21490852 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.measurement_id) AS kept_at_time FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.measurement_event_id = a.anaesthetic_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (21492241, 21490852) AND m.measurement_datetime >= a.start_datetime AND (a.end_datetime IS NULL OR m.measurement_datetime <= a.end_datetime) AND NOT (m.measurement_concept_id = 21492241 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.measurement art_before WHERE art_before.measurement_event_id = m.measurement_event_id AND art_before.measurement_concept_id = 21490852 AND art_before.measurement_datetime <= m.measurement_datetime) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.measurement art_after WHERE art_after.measurement_event_id = m.measurement_event_id AND art_after.measurement_concept_id = 21490852 AND art_after.measurement_datetime >= m.measurement_datetime)) WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990004400'), stood AS (SELECT value_as_number, measurement_datetime, COALESCE(LEAD(measurement_datetime) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_datetime), end_datetime) AS until_datetime FROM reading WHERE kept_at_time = 1) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN value_as_number < 40 AND until_datetime IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(second, measurement_datetime, until_datetime) > 300 THEN 300 ELSE DATEDIFF(second, measurement_datetime, until_datetime) END ELSE 0 END), 0) / 60.0 AS minutes_below_40, COUNT(*) AS kept_readings FROM stood

expectations.says: The cuff mean of 60 is written beside the arterial means and points at the anaesthetic, so the choice of rule alone decides whether it counts.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.anaesthetic a ON a.anaesthetic_id = m.measurement_event_id JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990004400' AND m.measurement_concept_id = 21492241 AND m.value_as_number = 60

cases: A neonate of 10 days whose run of arterial means below 40 is interrupted by a cuff mean of 60 should give 4 minutes below 40 under the present rule, and 8 minutes when the arterial line alone is used once it is running.
